text:
maya: Heads-up — I want to propose we deliberately shrink the Optimize Toolkit MVP to get an enterprise pilot (ACME) live in ~6w. Focus areas: batching advisor (high-throughput), KV/prefix caching for chat latencies, and quantization recommendations with a safe eval-triggered fallback. Need quick alignment on acceptance criteria and which customer asks we defer.

devon: Agree on shrink. For quant: scope to int8 recs only for MVP and require an automatic fallback to fp16 if eval signals quality drop. We should also include a rough cost-delta estimate in the recommendation.

sam: For eval-triggered alerts, I'd keep it simple — user-configurable but for MVP default to a binary "regression" vs "ok". Adding multiple severities adds product work.

elaine: Note ACME asks for per-route thresholds + per-model baselines. That's a heavy lift. My recommendation: delay per-route for MVP and instead offer a single per-project toggle plus an onboarding doc for baselines.

maya: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Batching advisor provides suggestions that yield >=20% token-cost reduction on synthetic/high-throughput tests while keeping p99 latency increase <=10%
- Prefix/KV cache reduces repeated-prefix compute by >=30% on chat-style workloads
- Quantization recommendations include int8 presets; automatic fallback policy to fp16 when eval detects quality degradation
- Eval-triggered alert fires on evaluation set metric drop (configurable) and posts to webhook/ops channel with a susceptible example prompt
```

devon: We need a concrete threshold for "metric drop". Propose default = absolute drop of 3% (or relative 10%), with customers able to tighten/loosen per their eval sets.

sam: Add rollout/gating safety: any advisor-driven change should be a recommendation first, with one-click apply + canary rollout to 5% traffic and observability hooks.

maya: @devon good call — default X = absolute 3% for MVP, editable. We'll document tuning guidance for ACME.

elaine: Quick triage of ACME asks vs MVP: 
- Per-route thresholds -> DEFER to post-MVP
- Fine-grained quant profiles per GPU type -> MVP-lite: ship recommended presets (nvidia-A100, amd, cpu-int8) rather than per-instance tuning
- Telemetry retention for alerts -> ENTERPRISE ADD-ON (not MVP)
- Onboarding wizard for eval sets -> MVP-minimal: CSV upload + example eval script

sam: :thumbsup: Sounds reasonable. Who's writing the one-pager and eng ticket?

maya: I'll write the one-pager with ACs and a prioritized triage list, aim to send to PM + Eng by EOD. @prod-bot please create a ticket "mvp-scope-shrink" and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml.

prod-bot: created ticket RED-2345: mvp-scope-shrink, assigned to @maya. link: https://phabricator.internal/RED-2345

maya: Thanks — after the one-pager I'll schedule a 30m sync to lock owners and a tentative 6-week milestone plan.

sam: I can take the canary rollout checklist and the observability hooks.

devon: I'll draft the quant preset list + quick benchmarks for int8 vs fp16 to include in the doc.

elaine: I'll compose the ACME-facing onboarding note for eval sets and the "what we'll not ship in MVP" list for transparency.

maya: Great. If anyone sees a hard blocker for the 6w target, flag here asap.
